notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for an adapter-supplied rich FOM transportation type used by a timestamped ordinary attribute update delivered through Flush Queue Request, Time Advance Request Available, and Next Message Request Available. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, rich FOM, endpoint, callback model, logical-time implementation, and object, attribute, and transportation names. It reuses the standard alternate-advance oracle and adds custom transportation handle/name and callback-identity assertions without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador FOM object, attribute, transportation, declaration, time-management, alternate-advance, timestamped update, retraction, and lifecycle services with FederateAmbassador discovery, reflection, retraction, and grant callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador alternate time-advance and timestamped ordinary object-management declarations and FederateAmbassador callbacks
